name: Force majeure clause contradicts baseline schedule float

documents.title: EPC-SYN-LNG-11 Contract
documents.synthetic_text: Clause 17 - Force Majeure. Contractor is entitled to a time extension equal to the actual impact, capped at 30 calendar days aggregate over the project lifecycle. No float sharing is permitted.

documents.title: EPC-SYN-LNG-11 Schedule
documents.synthetic_text: Baseline reserves 60 days of owner float on the critical path for weather contingency. Critical path runs through cryogenic tank hydrotest. Two weather windows totalling 55 days are pre-allocated as FM absorbers.

documents.title: EPC-SYN-LNG-11 Budget
documents.synthetic_text: Contingency 4% of contract value. No explicit FM-related reserve. LDs 0.1% per day capped at 10%.

expected_issues.description_contains: Force majeure cap of 30 days conflicts with 60 days of weather float embedded in the baseline
Schedule float allocation assumes recoveries beyond contractual FM cap
